properties.evidence: Opposite answers on one axis, raised in the same breath. Absorbing DISSOLVES the boundary by pulling the code in; making the crates independently releasable SHARPENS the boundary and keeps it. Taken far enough, each makes the other pointless — there is nothing to release independently once it is vendored, and little reason to vendor once you can pin exactly what you want. ⚠️ NOT STRICTLY EXCLUSIVE, and the overlap is worth naming: option E here (reflow2 absorbs the three loose functions) IS option C there. So the design will have to pick a DIRECTION rather than a disjoint branch.
